# embedded-spa

> Cache-correct Axum responses for rust-embed SPAs with build-time identity,
> gzip, and Brotli representations.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/tomcatzh/embedded-spa
License: MIT
MSRV: Rust 1.85

## Agent entry points

- README and copy-paste integration: ./README.md
- Public API: ./src/lib.rs
- Runnable Axum example: ./examples/minimal.rs
- Nginx integration contract: ./tests/nginx/nginx.conf.template
- Full real-proxy test: ./scripts/test-nginx.sh
- Build-time precompression helper: ./scripts/precompress.mjs

## Required validation

Run `make check` after library or integration changes.
Run `make test-nginx` after changing HTTP, ETag, MIME, encoding, or cache logic.

## Non-negotiable invariants

1. ETag identifies the final transferred representation bytes.
2. identity, gzip, and Brotli representations have distinct strong ETags.
3. Responses with compressed siblings emit `Vary: Accept-Encoding`.
4. Missing assets are real `404` responses with `Cache-Control: no-store`.
5. SPA fallback occurs only when the request explicitly accepts `text/html`.
6. API routing belongs outside this crate and must be mounted before fallback.
7. The default request path performs no compression and no content hashing.
8. The opt-in `live-assets` development feature refreshes the asset list and
   ETag metadata on every request; use it only with filesystem-backed
   `rust-embed` debug builds.
